reply_text:
I can't set this up as a recurring job from here. The scheduler in this environment only delivers to gateway chat platforms or saves locally, and it has no route to this Slack-style DM, so a 09:00 digest would never reach you. I haven't created anything.

What I can do now: read #coastal-team (you're a member) and DM you a digest of anything new since a time you pick. If you want it every morning, ask a platform admin to set up a scheduled delivery to this DM.
